nodes.name: Schedule: Daily 8am
nodes.notes:
Runs daily at 8am to re-verify applied fixes.
Also triggerable manually via the Webhook trigger below.

nodes.name: Webhook: Manual Verify Trigger
nodes.notes:
POST body: { fix_id?: string, client_id?: string }
Optional — verify a specific fix or all pending fixes for a client.

nodes.name: HTTP: Fetch Applied Fixes
nodes.notes:
Fetches all fixes with status='applied' that haven't been verified yet.
Joins to audits table to get the original URL.

nodes.name: Split: One Item per Fix
nodes.notes: Splits the array of fixes so each one is processed individually.

nodes.name: HTTP: Re-Audit Site
nodes.notes: Re-runs a full audit on the site to check if the fix is now present.

nodes.name: Code: Check Fix Present
nodes.notes: Compares re-audit scores against fix-type thresholds to determine if fix is live.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: $json.verified ? 'verified' : 'applied', verified_at: $json.verified ? new Date().toISOString() : null, verify_reason: $json.reason, new_scores: $json.new_scores }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: Update Verification Status
nodes.notes: Updates fix row: status='verified' if confirmed, or keeps 'applied' with reason if not.
